patch.title: Anthropic’s IPO Reaches a Market-Defined Confirmation Milestone
patch.longFormSummary:
The public S-1 was filed October 26. Anthropic explicitly says the registration is not yet effective and its proposed symbol is ANT; applying for a symbol is distinct from an exchange assigning it. This forecast concerns the contract’s effectiveness/pricing/assigned-ticker trigger, not that already-completed filing or the later first trade.

  • On October 27, 2026 Kalshi bid/ask midpoints implied about 1% before November 1, 12% before November 16, 87% before December 1 and 93% before January 1, 2027. The November 16 to December 1 interval is now the largest quoted increase (about 75 points), so the modal announcement window has moved from early November to the second half of the month. Active contracts have traded roughly 2.3 million contracts in total; this is a contract count, not reported cash turnover. A qualifying SEC effectiveness declaration, IPO pricing or assigned ticker can resolve the contract before shares begin trading.
  • The bullets below were read on October 21, 2026 and are kept for comparison.
  • On October 21, 2026 Kalshi bid/ask midpoints implied 0.5% before November 1 and 73% before December 1. The November interval is the largest remaining quoted increase, with an estimated US$519,314.98 in contract-count-times-last-price dollar volume across active contracts. This estimate is not reported cash turnover. A qualifying SEC effectiveness declaration, IPO pricing or assigned ticker can resolve the contract before shares begin trading.
  • Polymarket separately priced actual listed shares opening for trading at 8.1% by November 15, 64.5% by November 30 and 80.5% by December 31, on US$5,189,588.61 event volume. Its largest remaining interval is November 16–30; this listing contract is not interchangeable with Kalshi’s earlier IPO-confirmation trigger.
  • On October 20, 2026 the Kalshi announcement ladder quoted before November1 at 0.5% and before December1 at 60% by bid/ask midpoints, placing 59.5 percentage points in November. November1 is the estimated start of that modal month, not a scheduled announcement day. Estimated contracts-times-last-price dollar amount was US$461,641.53; it is not exchange-reported turnover. Expired strikes with 0/1 quotes are not treated as 50% forecasts.
  • Kalshi lists a market under its IPOS category asking "When will Anthropic officially announce an IPO?" - series KXIPOANTHROPIC, event KXIPOANTHROPIC-DATE, with the KXIPOANTHROPIC-DATE-26DEC01 strike highlighted and $2,515,906 of volume shown; the page notes "11 more" strikes beyond the three displayed
  • The three strikes shown are Before Dec 1, 2026 at 50% (down 7), Yes 52¢ / No 49¢; Before Jan 1, 2027 at 74% (up 1), Yes 74¢ / No 27¢; and Before Feb 1, 2027 at 83% (down 3), Yes 85¢ / No 18¢
  • The order ticket at the foot of the page prices the same "Before Dec 1, 2026" contract at YES 52¢ / NO 49¢ but reads "Odds 54% chance", against the 50% quoted in the list above it; its max payout date is Mar 31, 2027
  • Resolution: "An IPO is confirmed if 1) the SEC declares the company's Form S-1 effective OR 2) the IPO is priced OR 3) a securities exchange has assigned a ticker to it", and any of those resolves the market Yes immediately "even if the company does not start trading until after Dec 1, 2026"; the outcome is verified from the New York Times, ABC, Bloomberg "and 5 others"
  • The market opened Apr 1, 2026 at 10:00am EDT and closes after the outcome occurs, with payout projected 30 minutes later: "This market will close and expire early if the event occurs. Otherwise, it closes by Nov 30, 2026 at 11:59pm EST."
  • Headlines carried on the market page: the New York Times on Sep 18, "Anthropic Pursues IPO Despite Its A.I. Safety Warnings", saying the company is expected to generate $100 billion in annualized revenue this year even as chief executive Dario Amodei calls for slowing down development of some advanced A.I. models; Fool.com the same day, "Anthropic Is Expected to Go Public in October"; and CNBC on Sep 13, "Anthropic walks tightrope to Nasdaq, pushing for a slowdown while pursuing $2 trillion valuation"
  • More recently, the Access IPOs Podcast episode #77 published on 19 September 2026 says "The Anthropic IPO is still on track for the end of October" and that host Craig does not think it will be delayed again, with segments on Anthropic listing on Nasdaq, NVIDIA as an anchor investor and whether Anthropic is profitable; it argues that by disclosing potential catastrophic risks Anthropic lowers its securities fraud liabilities

patch.title: Harry Kane Wins the 2026 Men’s Ballon d’Or in London
patch.description: Harry Kane wins the 2026 Men’s Ballon d’Or at London’s Palladium on October 26, ahead of Kylian Mbappé and Lamine Yamal. The prior market forecast correctly favoured the eventual winner.
patch.dateConfidenceReasoning: Confirmed: UEFA’s October 26 winner announcement and England Football identify Harry Kane as the winner at the London Palladium. Preserve the verified ceremony onset, October 26 at20:00 UTC.
patch.longFormSummary:
• UEFA and England Football confirm Harry Kane won the 2026 Men’s Ballon d’Or at the London Palladium on October 26, ahead of Kylian Mbappé and Lamine Yamal. The earlier snapshot’s leading candidate won; probabilities were not predicted voting shares. Older market passages below are historical pre-ceremony observations.
  • Morning October 26, 2026 public Polymarket snapshot: Harry Kane 63.3%, Kylian Mbappé 30.6%, Lamine Yamal 6.6%, with US$74,479,522 event volume. These are independent binary market prices, not vote shares or a declared winner. The page’s automated commentary is not used as factual evidence.
  • October 23, 2026 evening public Polymarket snapshot: Harry Kane 77.4%, Lamine Yamal 14.5%, Kylian Mbappé 6.9% and Lionel Messi 1.8%, with US$60,669,080 total event volume. These are independent binary market prices, not vote shares or a declared winner.
  • UEFA confirms the London Palladium Theatre and October 26 ceremony at 20:00 GMT / 21:00 CET. Thierry Henry and Kate Scott host. The pin uses the ceremony onset rather than Polymarket’s year-end fallback.
  • On October 22, 2026 at approximately 23:29 UTC, Polymarket’s Ballon d'Or Winner 2026 market reported US$58,886,912 total event volume and priced Harry Kane 77%; Lamine Yamal 15.9%; Kylian Mbappé 6.2%; Lionel Messi 1.5%. These are market-implied probabilities, not confirmed outcomes.
  • On October 21,2026 at 22:02 UTC, Polymarket’s Ballon d'Or Winner 2026 market reported US$57,160,071 event volume and priced Harry Kane 76.8%; Lamine Yamal 17.2%; Kylian Mbappé 4.2%; Lionel Messi 1.9%. These are market-implied probabilities, not confirmed outcomes.
  • On October 20, 2026, Polymarket’s Ballon d'Or Winner 2026 market reported US$55,126,865 event volume and priced Harry Kane 71.8%; Lamine Yamal 19.6%; Kylian Mbappé 4.3%; Lionel Messi 2.4%. These are dated market-implied probabilities, not confirmed outcomes.
  • The move marks the 70 th anniversary of the first Ballon d'Or, presented in 1956 to Sir Stanley Matthews “at a smaller and far less glamorous event in Blackpool” when he was already 41
  • Organisers said that “as the Ballon d'Or becomes of septuagenarian age, it is fitting in such a landmark year to celebrate the finest present-day exponents of the beautiful game in the beating heart of the country that first conceived of it”
  • The ceremony has been held at the Théâtre du Châtelet in Paris since 2019, and was typically staged in Zurich between 2010 and 2015 when it ran as the FIFA Ballon d'Or; the prize was created by France Football
  • Harry Kane is the clear favourite on both exchanges: 55% on Kalshi and 56% on Polymarket
  • Lamine Yamal is second at 22% on both, with Kylian Mbappé at 8%, and Polymarket adds Rodri at 5% and Lionel Messi at 4%
  • Each page disagrees with itself a little: Kalshi lists Kane at 55% while his trade panel reads “Odds 58% chance” against a 56¢ Yes, and Polymarket's context note gives Rodri 4.5% and Messi 4.2% where its outcome rows round to 5% and 4%
  • Volume is $9,703,480 on Kalshi, which opened its market on 23 January 2026, and $37,401,543 on Polymarket, which opened on 22 September 2025
  • Polymarket resolves on official information from France Football and resolves to “Other” if no 2026 winner is declared by 31 December 2026; Kalshi verifies its outcome “from ESPN, The New York Times, the Associated Press and 12 others” and closes by 30 December 2026 if the award has not been made
  • Polymarket's note credits Kane's lead to “a record 73-goal season for Bayern Munich and England, including 61 club strikes that delivered the Bundesliga and DFB-Pokal plus six World Cup goals en route to England's best finish since 1966”, along with his European Golden Shoe
  • Yamal's case rests on “Spain's World Cup triumph, Barcelona's La Liga success, and standout creativity at 19”
  • Yamal has also argued the award should go to the world's best player rather than the top scorer: a Soccer Daily round-up of 19 September 2026 reports Goal framing his remark as a swipe at Kane, with Yamal saying an 80-goal season should bring the top-scorer award instead, a separate distinction
  • The nominees were due to be announced on 8 September, the day the ceremony story was published
  • Related Polymarket contracts put Kane in the top three at 91% and the top five at 98%, and Alexia Putellas to win the 2026 Women's Ballon d'Or at 93%

  • Dollar turnover is estimated at US$59,668 by summing each strike’s traded-contract count multiplied by its last-trade dollar price. Kalshi contract counts are not dollar volume. This estimate can differ from exchange-displayed turnover, and last prices can lag the bid/ask quotes used above. No turnover amount is entered as the event’s cost.

It assumes flows improve over time and expects US$84 for the 2027 annual average.   • Across 30 strikes, approximately 129,355.46 traded contracts imply an estimatedUS$66,049 when each count is multiplied by its last-trade price. The event remains the October 30, 17:00 EDT observation; this October observation has not yet realized.
  • Across 30 current strikes the largest adjacent midpoint-implied band is US$98.99–100.99 (about 11.0 percentage points); the closest 50% threshold is US$106.99 at 47.0%. Estimated turnover is US$68,495, computed as contracts times last prices, not exact exchange-reported dollar volume. Earlier dated snapshots remain above. No realized October price is available; observation remains October 30,17:00 EDT.

Summed contracts times each last price gives an estimated US$67,667, not exact exchange-reported dollar turnover. Last-price changes can lower this estimate even when cumulative contract volume rises. The event remains the October 30,17:00 EDT observation; no October realized settlement is available.
